profile.summary: A San Francisco nonprofit, known as JCRC Bay Area, that works on behalf of the Bay Area Jewish community on issues such as social justice, combating hate and community safety. Through its Jewish Coalition for Literacy program, started in 1999, trained volunteers give one-on-one reading support to students in kindergarten through 3rd grade, with a focus on Title 1 schools.
